const cat = item.json['Category'] || '';
const subcat = item.json['Subcategory'] || '';
const subsubcat = item.json['Sub_subcategory'] || '';
const title = item.json._ebay_title || item.json['Title'] || '';
const searchText = `${subsubcat} ${subcat} ${cat} ${title}`.toLowerCase();
let categoryId = CATEGORY_MAP['default'];
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(CATEGORY_MAP)) {
  if (k !== 'default' && searchText.includes(k)) { categoryId = v; break; }
}
const sku = item.json['SKU'] || '';
const rawQty = parseInt(item.json['QOH'] || '0', 10);
const listQty = Math.min(rawQty > 0 ? rawQty : 1, 3);

// Item specifics extraction
const desc = (item.json['Description'] || '').toLowerCase();
let material = 'High Quality Material';
const matMatches = [{ k: 'carbon fiber', v: 'Carbon Fiber' }, { k: 'fiberglass', v: 'Fiberglass' }, { k: 'stainless steel', v: 'Stainless Steel' }, { k: 'aluminum alloy', v: 'Aluminum Alloy' }, { k: 'pu leather', v: 'PU Leather' }, { k: 'memory foam', v: 'Memory Foam' }, { k: 'oxford', v: 'Oxford Fabric' }, { k: 'canvas', v: 'Canvas' }, { k: 'corduroy', v: 'Corduroy' }, { k: 'abs', v: 'ABS Plastic' }, { k: 'silicone', v: 'Silicone' }, { k: 'tpe', v: 'TPE' }, { k: 'pvc', v: 'Heavy Duty PVC' }];
for (const m of matMatches) { if (`${title} ${desc}`.toLowerCase().includes(m.k)) { material = m.v; break; } }
let colour = 'Multicoloured';
const colours = ['Black', 'White', 'Grey', 'Gray', 'Blue', 'Pink', 'Purple', 'Green', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Yellow', 'Khaki', 'Beige', 'Red', 'Orange'];
for (const c of colours) { if (new RegExp(`\\b${c}\\b`, 'i').test(title)) { colour = c === 'Gray' ? 'Grey' : c; break; } }
let power = 'Manual / Non-Electric';
if (desc.includes('solar')) power = 'Solar Powered';
else if (desc.includes('rechargeable')) power = 'USB Rechargeable Battery';
else if (desc.includes('usb')) power = 'USB Powered';

let department = 'Unisex Adults';
if (searchText.includes('women') || searchText.includes('lady') || searchText.includes('hobo bag') || searchText.includes('handbag')) department = 'Women';
else if (searchText.includes('men') || searchText.includes('wallet')) department = 'Men';

let style = 'Modern';
if (searchText.includes('hobo')) style = 'Hobo Bag';
else if (searchText.includes('tote')) style = 'Tote';
else if (searchText.includes('shoulder')) style = 'Shoulder Bag';
else if (searchText.includes('backpack')) style = 'Backpack';
else if (searchText.includes('chest rig')) style = 'Tactical Bag';

const ebayRow = {
  '*Action': 'Add',
  '*Title': item.json._ebay_title,
  '*Category': categoryId,
  'CustomLabel': `DSZ-${sku}`,
  '*ConditionID': '1000',
  '*StartPrice': item.json._ebay_price,
  '*Quantity': listQty,
  '*Format': 'FixedPrice',
  '*Duration': 'GTC',
  'ShippingType': 'Free',
  'ShippingService-1:Option': 'AU_StandardDelivery',
  'ShippingService-1:Cost': '0.00',
  'DispatchTimeMax': '1',
  'Country': 'AU',
  '*Location': 'Australia',
  'PicURL': item.json._ebay_images,
  'C:Brand': 'Unbranded',
  'C:Model': `DSZ-${sku}`,
  'C:Type': subsubcat || subcat || 'Accessories',
  'C:Material': material,
  'C:Colour': colour,
  'C:Department': department,
  'C:Style': style,
  'C:Power Source': power,
  'C:Features': 'Portable, Lightweight, Durable',
  'C:MPN': `DSZ-${sku}`,
  'Description': item.json._ebay_description_html
};
return { json: ebayRow };
